entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ravi Prakash Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Arvind Singh, learned counsel for the
applicant and Sri Pankaj Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Criminal
Case No. 2993 of 2016 arising out of F.I.R./Case Crime No. 75 of 2005, under Sections 376, 452,
354, 323, 504, 506 of Ipc, Police Station Bakewar, District Etawah, with a prayer to enlarge him on
anticipatory bail.

3.  As per prosecution story, on 13.01.2003, there was an altercation between the applicant and the informant and his nephew Amar Singh and in this regard, an NCR was instituted by the nephew of the informant Amar Singh on 14.01.2003.

The husband of the informant Rajendra Singh had also Sanjay Singh@ Bablu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51370823/
1 lodged a complaint before the Judicial Magistrate, concerned on 29.01.2003 u/s 452, 354, 323, 504,
506 of IPC regarding the same date of occurrence i.e. on 13.01.2003.

entities.text: Sanjay Singh@ Bablu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The informant Smt. Soni has also lodged the FIR on 15.05.2005 in respect of the same incident occurred on 13.01.2003.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is maliciously being prosecuted in the present case due to ulterior motive and has apprehension of his arrest.
He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the prosecution.
Learned counsel has further stated that the FIR is delayed by about two years and four months and it has been instituted after due deliberation and legal consultation.
The present FIR has been instituted in respect of same date and time of incident alleging that rape was committed with her in addition to outraging her modesty.
Learned counsel has further stated that the present FIR is hit by Section 300 Cr.P.C. as already an NCR was there.

After investigation, the final report (charge-sheet) has been submitted, as such, the applicant had challenged it by filing a petition u/s 482 Cr.P.C. No.18495 of 2005 wherein interim protection was granted to him but the same has been vacated in the light of the judgment of the Apex Court passed in Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Pvt. and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in 2018 (16) SCC 299.
5.

entities.text: Asian Resurfacing of Road Agency Pvt. and Another vs. Central Bureau of Investigation reported in 2018 (16) SCC 299
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history.
In case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed, he will not misuse the liberty and shall cooperate with trial.

6. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

7. Considering the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98", the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

11. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Siddhant  Sanjay Singh@ Bablu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51370823/
